_comment: 7 ops, ~70k MACs -- the floor case, and it behaves like one. Whole network is 0.028 ms on CPU int8; k=2 is 0.029 ms and k=4 is 0.026 ms, i.e. indistinguishable, while on the DSP each of the 4 tiles costs a full 0.357-0.372 ms dispatch for 0.006-0.026 ms of work. HTA is blocked by elu_s8 at every granularity except the trailing Gemm-only tile, which does compose (0.541 ms) and is 250x slower than the 0.002 ms CPU cell. Never slice this network.

_provenance.statistic: median of per-sweep median_us, performance governor, CPU cells unmasked
_provenance.op_index_space: ops:'all' -- whole network, so no index space is involved.
